This instrument performs it once under the identical frozen cohort rule (segment=small, non-contaminated, t_ic>=2.0 AND t_excess_gross>=1.5 AND t_excess_net<1.5 from banked batch*_summary.csv). DISCLOSED at registration: batch1/batch2 summaries were on screen during the motivating audit, so two cohort members (fscore_lite, cash_prof) were visible before the doc was written; the rule is verbatim from a 2026-07-26 freeze with no free parameter, batches 3-9 were not inspected, and the deciding metric (KO re-scan + confirm) was not computed
expected_effect: Re-scan cohort members, explore 2004-2018 small, three cost arms: KO half-spread (PRIMARY), KO full-spread (STRESS), zero-cost (BOUND, descriptive). Graduation = t_excess_net>=1.5 AND t_ic>=2.0 under BOTH primary and stress. Any graduate -> ONE confirm run 2019-2024 small KO-half: PASS iff mean net excess>0 AND t_net>=0.8 AND t_ic>=1.5. Always reported: mechanical-relief decomposition (mean_traded x delta_bps), DSR at n_trials=160, turnover, flat-25 vs KO side by side. +1 candidate -> cumulative 160
kill_condition: Cohort empty OR no member clears the bar under BOTH cost arms -> small-cap cost-killed shelf CLOSED permanently, matching largemid, and no further cost-model appeals exist for EITHER segment. No re-tuning of bar, segment bounds, cost arm or window; a different cost model is a new registration. Confirm rule identical: any bar missed -> REJECT, no re-reading

name: INSTR-RESID-MOM
hypothesis: Residual (idiosyncratic) momentum - 12-1 momentum computed on FF3 RESIDUALS rather than total returns - earns positive net excess in the long-only top decile where total-return momentum does not, because residualising the formation return removes the time-varying factor loadings that produce momentum crashes. Spec frozen verbatim from Blitz-Huij-Martens (JEmpFin 2011): OLS on mktrf/smb/hml over months m-35..m (all 36 required), signal = mean(residual over m-11..m-1)/stdev(same window), direction +1. Admissible against the CLOSED momentum family as a NEW MECHANISM CLASS: #13/#14 both ranked TOTAL return and differed only in when the book was held (the timing mechanism, which failed twice); this changes WHAT is ranked. Supporting prior: Blitz-Hanauer-Vidojevic IRFA 2020 report post-publication OOS survival, ~half the volatility, and absence of the long-term reversal that drives momentum crashes. Prior-check run 2026-07-30, 86 hits reviewed, no prior residualised-formation registration
expected_effect: Byte-identical factory harness, explore 2004-2018, both segments. Bars declared now: largemid at flat 25 bps, small under KO half-spread (the measured small-cap cost per INSTR-COST-MODEL; flat-25 small reported alongside as the comparability bridge). Graduation in either segment = t_excess_net>=1.5 AND t_ic>=2.0 -> ONE confirm run 2019-2024, same segment, same cost arm: PASS iff net excess>0 AND t_net>=0.8 AND t_ic>=1.5. DSR at n_trials=162, FF6 alpha reported. Reported never deciding: turnover, maxDD (BHM's headline claim is risk reduction, so a REJECT with materially shallower maxDD than mom_12_1 is a meaningful negative result), paired comparison vs banked mom_12_1. +2 candidates -> cumulative 162
kill_condition: No graduate in EITHER segment -> residual-momentum family CLOSED and the momentum family closed at BOTH total-return and residual resolution; no third variant without a mechanism class distinct from both timing and residualisation. Frozen and non-negotiable: 36-month estimation window, FF3 model, m-11..m-1 signal window, standardisation by residual sd, direction +1. Sign flip = new candidate in a future batch, not a free retry. HONEST PRIOR DECLARED WEAK with specific adverse evidence: banked mom_12_1 small shows t_ic +3.05 with t_gross -1.50 (net -39.7 bps/mo) - the binding constraint is the BOOK, not the wall, and a rank-improving transform must turn a gross-negative book positive. Expected outcome: IC improves, book stays negative, 0 graduates

name: INSTR-CS-SPREAD
hypothesis: The Kyle-Obizhaeva half-spread frame (INSTR-COST-MODEL: largemid 3.4-4.2 bps, small 11.6-13.1 bps) is load-bearing for the paper's lead exhibit (empty cost-killed cohort, NEG_RESULTS 22 + INSTR-COST-REMEASURE-REJECTS) and has never been cross-checked against an independent estimator. Corwin-Schultz (JF 2012) high-low spread was recorded INFEASIBLE at INSTR-COST-MODEL time for a stated reason - no daily high/low in the pull. The P0 harvest (2026-07-30) landed crsp.dsf full universe 2002-2024 with askhi/bidlo, 24.0M rows, 100% non-null in audit. Estimator frozen verbatim from the paper incl. the overnight gap adjustment and the negative-to-zero convention; monthly mean of daily two-day estimates, >=10 valid pairs per name-month, reported as one-way half-spread bps for direct comparability with the KO frame
expected_effect: Compare CS vs KO on the SAME name-months, both segments, three eras. (1) SANITY GATE: CS median in [1,100] bps both segments AND small>largemid. (2) PRIMARY rank agreement: pooled Spearman(CS,KO) >= 0.30. (3) CO-PRIMARY level agreement: median CS/KO ratio within [0.5,2.0] both segments. Verdicts declared before the run: both pass -> KO VALIDATED, empty cohort stands on a cross-checked ruler; primary passes and level fails HIGH (>2.0) -> KO UNDERSTATES costs, cohort must be re-derived under CS and the paper's lead exhibit may change; level fails LOW (<0.5) -> KO overstates, empty-cohort conclusion strengthens; primary fails -> NO CONCLUSION about KO, report disagreement and change nothing. +1 candidate -> cumulative 163
kill_condition: One shot. Instrument re-measures a COST SCALAR ONLY - it cannot revive any signal, and no spec/direction/window/bar of any candidate changes here. If it invalidates KO the consequence is a NEW registration to re-derive the cohort, never an automatic reopening. No tuning: no winsorising beyond the published zero-floor, no outcome-conditional filtering, no alternative estimator swapped in after seeing the number. HONEST PRIOR: rank corr 0.3-0.6 expected to pass; CS/KO level ratio expected above 1 in both segments and plausibly above 2 in small, where CS is known noisy and gap-biased - if small fails high, NEG_RESULTS 22 is the first thing that must be re-derived

name: TRIAL-ABIO-KIRK
hypothesis: Kirk (2025, JAAF 41:524-546, DOI 10.1177/0148558x251319189) reports 76 bps/mo next-month high-minus-low from ABNORMAL institutional ownership (actual IO residualised on firm characteristics), 2.29M firm-months 1984-2022. Claim under test: the abnormal component of IO carries cross-sectional information that raw IO does not, and survives the harness net of costs. Distinct construction from all five rejected 13F variants (best_ideas, breadth_chg, inst_persist x2, own_dur_t10 - all real-IC/dead-net). Three arms, EACH a candidate (164-166): io_level (raw fraction), io_chg (qoq change - out-of-family test of NEG_RESULTS 24 flow finding), io_abn (residual of quarterly cross-sectional OLS on log mktcap, mom_12_1, log 3m dollar vol, 1/price, log firm age; Kirk-STYLE not verbatim, our characteristic set frozen at registration). io = inst_shares/(shrout*1000), tr13f cusip -> crsp_stocknames ncusip date-valid link, ambiguous links dropped, per-quarter 1/99 winsorisation, availability lag fdate+60cd <= formation month-end (conservative vs 45d statutory). DECLARED PRIOR WEAK-NEGATIVE: INSTR-RESID-MOM receipt (residualisation stripped the information, fitted leg IC t 2.80 of 2.84), CZ-CALIB fame decay (-0.544) on a large published effect, five-for-five real-IC/dead-net 13F family history.
expected_effect: Explore 2004-2018 only, factory scan_signal, largemid+small, EW-universe benchmark, 30 pct hold band, deciles. Deciding cost arms largemid@flat25 and small@KO-half with zero-cost bound and flat25 guard reported alongside (post-CS-SPREAD interval convention). Graduation: t_ic >= 2.0 AND t_gross >= 1.5 AND t_net >= 1.5 per segment; only a graduate earns the one confirm shot (2019-2024: net>0 AND t_net>=0.8 AND t_ic>=1.5). PRE-DECLARED DECISIVE COMPARISON regardless of graduation: if t_ic(io_abn) <= t_ic(io_level) + 0.5 pooled, the finding is residualisation-added-nothing - NEG_RESULTS 23 repeated in a second construction class. Honest prediction: io_abn IC t 1.5-3.0 with net t < 1.0 largemid; io_chg highest IC + highest turnover + dead net; no arm graduates.
kill_condition: One shot per arm; no spec, lag, winsorisation, characteristic set or bar changes after this commit; crash-before-readable repairable (disclosed), completed run final. No forward lane seeded under any outcome. Disclosed limitations: 13F restatements unresolved in tr13f (Cao-Da-Jiang-Yang MS 2026), s34 double-counting handled only by frozen winsorisation, shrout month-end vs fdate quarter-end misalignment on corporate actions. Run assigned to next Opus session; registration deliberately precedes any run code.

name: TRIAL-OPT-COHORT
hypothesis: Option markets price information about the underlying that the equity cross-section has not yet impounded. Seven constructs as ONE pre-declared cohort (candidates 167-173), directions declared at freeze: iv_atm (30d ATM IV, -1), riv_spread (IV minus 21d realised, -1, Alexiou-Rompolis 2021), skew_25d (25-delta put minus call IV, -1, Xing-Zhang-Zhao 2010), term_slope (91d minus 30d ATM IV, +1, Vasquez 2017/Kim 2020), os_ratio (option/stock volume, +1, Johnson-So 2012), pc_volume (put/call volume, -1, Pan-Poteshman 2006), skew_resid (per-month cross-sectional residual of skew_25d on log mktcap + 21d realised vol + mom_12_1 + log 3m dollar vol, Wu-Tian 2023 STYLE not verbatim, -1). DECLARED PRIOR WEAK-NEGATIVE: NEG_RESULTS 23+26 both against skew_resid (residualisation has failed in two construction classes; prediction t_ic(skew_resid) <= t_ic(skew_25d)); CZ-CALIB fame decay against skew_25d and pc_volume. House predictions: riv_spread most likely survivor at IC t 1.0-2.0 net t < 1.0; os_ratio highest turnover dead net; iv_atm subsumed by banked vol candidates; 0-1 arms graduate. External forecasts R15-2/R15-3 attached as scoreable (Perplexity round-16 restatement logged as echo, scored once via R15-2).
expected_effect: Explore 2004-2018 only, factory scan_signal, largemid + optionable-small, EW-universe benchmark, 30 pct hold band, deciles, deciding arms largemid@flat25 and small@KO-half with zero-cost bound + flat25 guard reported (post-25 interval convention). Graduation t_ic>=2.0 AND t_gross>=1.5 AND t_net>=1.5 per segment; graduate earns one confirm shot (2019-2024: net>0 AND t_net>=0.8 AND t_ic>=1.5) with Murat authorisation required before confirm is read. FROZEN NULL RULE: name-month with null in the arm required surface field is DROPPED (no ffill, no imputation); drop rate reported split by VIX tercile (stress-correlated missingness 0.8 pct 2004-06 vs 13.0 pct 2020); arms with top-tercile drop rate > 2x bottom also report IC sign+t on the >=95 pct always-covered subsample, reported never deciding.
